title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.37834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected bra

translated_title: 面向智能体脚手架优化的自我改进分支混合方法
translated_abstract: 脚手架优化为递归自我改进（RSI）提供了一个实用的应用场景，其中智能体生成的修改通过执行反馈来指导后续的变更。近期的工作如Meta-Harness通过迭代式的代码生成和评估来实现这一过程，但保留了固定的开发集和提案策略。这些约束使进化被限制在单一的搜索轨迹上，增加了收敛到局部最优的风险。我们通过将搜索组织成多个分支来使改进过程本身具有自适应性，每个分支拥有不断演化的开发子集和提案策略。每个分支保留那些被本分支领先脚手架解决次数多于其他分支领先脚手架的开发用例，丢弃被所有分支的所有领先脚手架都能解决的用例，并利用自身的搜索历史来修订其提案策略。为了部署由此产生的互补脚手架，我们提出了一个路由器来选择由开发集选出的分支（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将递归自我改进的搜索过程组织为多个拥有动态演化开发集和提案策略的分支，并通过路由器部署由此得到的互补优化脚手架，从而避免单一搜索轨迹陷入局部最优。
